notes: This is a dedicated recheck of get_custom_field_dataset against production, and it came back BLOCKED rather than PASS or DRIFT: every invoke of the capability itself returned 403 'This action is not permitted for the user' with an SSO login prompt, regardless of which valid (custom_fields_id, dataset_id) pair was used or whether fetch_options was set. This was verified not to be a fluke of one bad id pair (tried two independent pairs discovered live via get_project_form_fields) and not to be specific to the fetch_options=true parameter (bare call also 403s). It was further verified to be systemic across the entire v2 custom_field capability family on this prod session -- get_custom_field, list_workspace_fields and list_custom_fields all 403 identically -- while the v1 endpoint used for setup (get_project_form_fields) succeeds normally and returns real option data inline for the same project (332537). Point 1 (declared options type) could still be settled from describeCapability alone: the contract is unchanged from preprod -- options is declared as a bare array, with no options.info envelope mentioned. Points 3 through 6 (options-as-object-with-info, option row shape/descriptor variant, duplicate-option-id doubling, and the paging-helper reliability sub-check) could NOT be settled on prod at all in this session -- they are UNVERIFIED, not PASS, because the capability under test never returned a 2xx body to inspect. Per the task's own rule, an error body was never diffed against the preprod success schema to manufacture a verdict. Root cause is very likely a permission/role gap on this specific prod credential (missing 'field-view' permission for the v2 custom-field surface) rather than evidence that the preprod DRIFT has been fixed or still reproduces -- reproduces_preprod is left null (unknown) rather than true/false for that reason. This needs either a prod session with the field-view permission granted, or escalation to whoever owns prod credentials for this capability index, before the DRIFT can actually be confirmed fixed or reconfirmed on production.
